decisions.decision: Place the benefit-year selector in the company context row and use it as the single scope across company pages.
decisions.reason: Historical products, plans, members, claims, and panel setup must remain visibly tied to the same selected benefit year during navigation.

decisions.decision: Use full-width sticky portal navigation; limit the champagne cloth background to the Home hero and message/limit panels; place care icons inside the limits panel; use a dark claim action and a temporary silver Inspro card preview only when insurer artwork is unavailable.
decisions.reason: The member chose the final hero, two-panel, and compact-strip composition from the reviewed reference image while requiring actual insurer artwork to take precedence.
